conventions.invariants: [] is zero; [0] is Z; positive entries are cyclic torsion orders, in GAP's order

quantity.full group: the abelian invariants of the stacking group of the whole E6 line of the degree
quantity.group of the E6 layers with p >= 1: the abelian invariants of the stacking group of the E6 layers with p >= 1, that is without the layer at p=0 (Kitaev at k=2, p+ip at k=3): the filtration stage of koFull below that layer; for k >= 4 no layer has p=0 and it is the full group
quantity.E6 layers: the E6 cells of the line, one invariant list per layer; null marks a cell the paper leaves blank

conventions.twist_coordinates: s and omega are binary cocycle vectors in the basis of the resolution that group_expression constructs (a group is resolved by ResolutionFiniteGroup of length cutoff+3); 0 is the zero cocycle
conventions.group_expression: a GAP expression for the bosonic quotient group, or for its integral HAP resolution; SGC_ResolutionSpaceGroup needs the SpaceGroupCohomology package
conventions.scope: Full stacking groups, including intrinsic invertible phases, unless the quantity says otherwise; not products of E6 layers

wang_gu_2020.location: Appendix E.2, Table VII, printed page 67; cocycles in equations (E23)-(E24)
wang_gu_2020.note: Tables III and VI exclude intrinsic Kitaev and p+ip phases in dimensions one and two; Table VII includes them.

wang_gu_2020_table_iii.location: Table III, printed page 8; cyclic carry cocycle in equation (E2), printed page 64; quaternion cocycle in equation (E26), printed page 69
wang_gu_2020_table_iii.comparison_kind: fermionic SPT phases of finite unitary groups in dimensions one to three, without the intrinsic Kitaev and p+ip layers
wang_gu_2020_table_iii.note: The rows 2, 3 and 12 are families; the cases instantiate them. The bosonic quotient is G_f/Z2^f, and omega is the extension class of G_f: zero for the split products, the cyclic carry u_m for Z_{2m}^f, x^2 for Z4^Tf and x^2+xy+y^2 for Q8^f.

ren_ning_qi_wang_gu_2024.location: Tables I-IV (wallpaper groups); equation (6.2) for the time-reversal twists
ren_ning_qi_wang_gu_2024.comparison_kind: stacking groups of the MC (1,-1), CF (2,-2) and B (4,-4) layers of 2+1D crystalline fermionic SPT phases, package degree 3
ren_ning_qi_wang_gu_2024.note: Table I: spin-1/2 (s=w1, omega=0). Table II: spinless (s=w1, omega=w2+w1^2). Table III: spin-1/2 with time reversal (s=w1+t, omega=t^2+w1 t). Table IV: spinless with time reversal (s=w1+t, omega=w2+w1^2+w1 t). The p+ip layer (0,0) is not part of the tables, and p1 is omitted from Tables III and IV.

zhang_ning_qi_gu_2024.location: Table I, printed page 4; Section V, printed page 47; Supplement S-3.1-S-3.2, printed page 54
zhang_ning_qi_gu_2024.comparison_kind: three-dimensional crystalline topological superconductors, package degree 4
zhang_ning_qi_gu_2024.note: The point groups act on space by the integral matrices of group_expression; s is the determinant character, omega is zero for spin-1/2 and w2 of the spatial representation for spinless fermions. Reflection becomes antiunitary internal symmetry and spinless/spin-1/2 are exchanged by the stated crystalline equivalence. Table II concerns charge-conserving insulators and is not used.

spacegroups_2512.location: Tables I and II, PDF pages 6-7; twists on printed page 24
spacegroups_2512.comparison_kind: E6 layers of the spin-1/2 electronic case of the 230 space groups, package degree 4
spacegroups_2512.note: Only the layers p+ip (1,0), Kitaev (2,-1), complex fermion (3,-2) and bosonic (5,-4) are tabulated, with s=w1 and omega=0; extensions between them are not determined. SG210, SG219 and SG228 have unreported cells.
